title: Write My Own Memory Rules
goal: Add your own rule and watch the robot remember.
mascot_lines: The best memory rules are the ones that fit YOUR work.
If you change how you code, you change the rules to match.
Tiny rules are easier to follow than one giant blob of words.
And if a rule isn't helping anymore, we just toss it out.

tier2.rephrase: Type a sentence about your favorite color.

tier3.nudge: Try: 'My favorite color is blue' (or any color you like!).

questions.math_tip: Add the ones first. Ten ones can be regrouped as one ten.

variations.prompt: What is 57 plus 16?

questions.math_tip: If there are not enough ones, trade one ten for ten ones.

variations.prompt: What is 41 minus 26?

questions.math_tip: Read hundreds, tens, then ones. Each place is worth ten times the place to its right.

variations.prompt: In 322, which digit is in the ones place?
